8144.title: Idle timeline notices lack recovery without an applicable push
8144.rootCauseOneLine: An active timeline notice marks an unseen sequence, but no fallback fetch runs when its push is missing or rejected for a different window class.
8144.proposedFix: Trace and reproduce the desktop subscription/visibility transition before choosing a lifecycle repair or bounded stale-sequence recovery policy.
8144.caveats: Only the cache-boundary failure was repeated; the macOS desktop/Pi trigger is unverified. Browser Automation lacked Chrome/Chromium, so no screenshot is claimed. No PR: a speculative recovery policy would fail the simple-fix gate.
